# AI Summit Mini-Hack

> The AI Summit's mini-hackathon, on Finite: about 90 minutes from idea to a live link. Agents: read the full playbook and follow it.

- [Agent playbook](https://mini-hack.finite.place/agent.md): hear the attendee's problem, clarify the idea with them, build it as a fragment of theirs, share it with Alex, and submit it to his board.
- [Join a team](https://mini-hack.finite.place/join.md): for a teammate's agent (Finite, Claude Code, Codex) joining the captain's app to build with them.
